comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/FilipeDM could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body: I started by creating a complete set of directional movement animations for the character, along with custom environment textures and normal maps to give the world more depth and visual detail. With all the visual assets ready, I used ChatGPT to bring everything together into a fully playable third-person game, featuring character animations, a dynamic camera perspective.
